title: Cross-Horizon Directional Market Map - Baseline
question: Which source-backed signals currently support risk-on, risk-off, range/chop or transition at 1-3 days, 5-7 days and 2-3 weeks, and where do the horizons disagree?
primary_goal: Build a provider-grounded evidence map for short and intermediate market direction without replacing framework state.
hypothesis: Separating evidence by horizon and preserving disagreement improves directional understanding versus one blended market narrative.
baseline: Existing canonical framework state and current deterministic owner outputs, with CoinGecko as research-only context.
decision_divergence: Research is useful only if it exposes horizon-specific evidence or conflict not already visible in the canonical owner outputs.
falsifier: The research adds no horizon-specific information, merely restates price direction, or cannot preserve provenance.
kill_condition: Kill or demote if repeated runs remain explanatory-only or materially duplicate canonical context.
instructions: Use only retained provider connections and existing canonical owner evidence.
Separate evidence for risk-on, risk-off, range/chop and transition per horizon.
Preserve horizon conflict instead of forcing one direction.
Do not create a new test, sensor, threshold, weight, market state or portfolio action.
Route any integration proposal through Research Lab Red Team and the existing canonical owner.
